description: This file contains utility functions for handling haptic feedback data, including scaling and clipping of vibration amplitude buffers, as well as validation of haptic scale types.

methods.name: getHapticScaleGamma
methods.description: Returns gamma correction factor based on the haptic scale.

methods.name: getHapticMaxAmplitudeRatio
methods.description: Returns maximum amplitude ratio based on the haptic scale.

methods.name: applyHapticScale
methods.description: Applies scaling to the haptic buffer based on the specified scale.

methods.name: clipHapticData
methods.description: Clips the haptic buffer data to a specified limit.

methods.name: isValidHapticScale
methods.description: Checks if the provided haptic scale is valid.

methods.name: scaleHapticData
methods.description: Scales and clips haptic buffer data based on scale and limit.
